thread:
alex_t: quick sync — we need to firm up scope for the cost+observability panel we're shipping next sprint. aim: get a shippable GA slice that answers pilot customers.

maria_k: summary of customer asks: consolidated route-level cost, correlation of errors to cost spikes, trace drilldown from error rows, and the ability to throttle noisy endpoints via sampling. also a basic paging alert for error bursts.

samir: engineering realities: full-fidelity traces for every request is expensive. we should do lightweight trace links (trace id lookup) and a sampling path for capture. also need to ensure older pipelines preserve trace_id in logs.

jordan_p: can we define minimal acceptance criteria? i want to produce an API contract and dev estimate.

emily: proposed GA acceptance: 1) Route cost widget (token buckets + sparkline) 2) Error-rate heatmap with top-10 endpoints and counts 3) Trace-link action on error row -> opens full trace viewer in new tab (if trace available) 4) Sampling presets (low/medium/high) in UI 5) PagerDuty webhook integration (MVP) 6) Retention setting visible (default 7d).

maria_k: add that PD integration must support single escalation rule for trial customers. keep required fields minimal.

samir: notes: to make trace-link reliable we need consistent trace_id propagation. new SDKs have it, older customers scrub it. patching across multiple ingestion pipelines could add ~1 week of infra work.

alex_t: tradeoffs to log: 7d vs 30d retention; default presets vs slider for sampling; precomputing route-cost vs live queries (latency).

jordan_p: ballpark dev: route-cost + heatmap + trace-link (light) + sampling presets = ~3 dev-weeks. PD hook + retention UI = ~1 dev-week. 30d retention or live-heavy cost attribution each add ~2 dev-weeks.

emily: one pilot (payments startup) requested 30d. we should gate extended retention for Dedicated/Enterprise. default Hosted -> 7d.

samir: agree. plan: Default 7d for Hosted. Expose retention in advanced settings, controlled by billing plan. Dedicated gets opt-in config for 30d.

alex_t: UI copy: need a clear billing warning when users toggle >7d. maria, can you draft?

maria_k: i'll draft language and run legal. emily will produce a small mock of the panel (cost + heatmap + tiny "view trace" link).

emily: i'll have mocks by EOD. will show a compact row with sparkline, numeric cost, error badge, and "traces" button.

jordan_p: sampling UX: engineering prefers named presets to avoid edge cases. propose low=1%, med=5%, high=20%. we can replace with slider later if requested.

samir: infra checklist: add sampling flag to routing policy, ensure serializer passes trace_id, add circuit-breaker around trace-forwarding to avoid cascading failures, and surface KV cache hit metrics per route. sampling changes must not invalidate KV caches.

alex_t: rollout plan?

maria_k: propose staged rollout: 5 pilot orgs for 48h, monitor CPU, median token latency, and error surface; expand to 50 orgs for 72h; then full GA. Gate: <3% increase in median token latency and no more than 5% increase in error-rate attributable to trace capture.

emily: i'll produce the monitoring dashboard and include an id in the rollout doc.

jordan_p: API contract (draft): GET /console/traces?trace_id=XYZ -> 200 with minimal trace metadata + deep link to trace viewer; 204 if trace not found. Will include response schema in product board.

opsbot: deploybot: feature gate created: name=obs-rollup-v1, env=staging, owners=[samir,jordan_p]

alex_t: decisions: ship GA with must-haves: route-cost, heatmap, trace-link (light), sampling presets, PD hook, retention default 7d. Gate 30d behind enterprise. Use presets initially. Rollout per maria's plan.

maria_k: I'll update the roadmap doc, add owners and dates. next actions: emily mock, samir infra plan, jordan finalize API contract, alex coordinate pilot customers.

emily: mock link shared (internal): https://mockup.redwood/in/rollup-001 — please comment. :thumbsup:

samir: infra plan posted: add sampling flag, trace-id passthrough, circuit breaker + metrics alerts on trace-forwarder errors (>5% error rate triggers fallback to link-only behavior).

jordan_p: pushed API draft to product board. expect feedback from infra this afternoon.

alex_t: thanks all. we'll reconvene in 48h after mocks + infra doc. ping me for blockers. :rocket:
